cases.answer: Perusahaan memiliki toko di 12 kota.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_head_office_employees FROM analytics.dim_employee AS e WHERE e.is_active = TRUE AND e.store_id IS NULL
cases.answer: There are 30 active employees at head office rather than in a store.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.discount_idr) AS discounts_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)

cases.sql: SELECT s.courier, ROUND(CAST(AVG((CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) - CAST((s.shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE))) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS s WHERE s.shipment_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY s.courier

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS whatsapp_tickets FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE t.contact_channel = 'whatsapp' AND CAST((t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
cases.answer: There were 1,231 support tickets opened through WhatsApp during the available 2026 data window, from January first through September thirtieth; data for the remaining months is unavailable.

cases.sql: SELECT c.channel_code AS channel, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel_code

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
cases.answer: A total of 291,021 store visitors were recorded during 2025.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_purchase_orders FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po WHERE po.po_status = 'open'
cases.answer: There are 55 purchase orders still open, based on orders marked open as of the end of the data.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.csat_score) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS avg_csat_score FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE t.csat_score IS NOT NULL
cases.answer: The average CSAT score across rated support tickets is 3.86.

cases.sql: WITH line_net AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, p.category_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_item_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_item_id) SELECT c.category_name AS subcategory, SUM(ln.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM line_net AS ln JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = ln.category_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = ln.order_item_id WHERE c.level = 2 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: Used English subcategory names from dim_category.category_name.
cases.answer: The top subcategories by net revenue in the calendar year were Smartphones (IDR 20.1B), Audio (IDR 14.8B), and Computers & Accessories (IDR 11.1B).

cases.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_cost_idr) AS purchase_order_value_idr FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.ordered_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.ordered_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.po_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY purchase_order_value_idr DESC LIMIT 5

Perhitungan menggunakan tanggal PO dibuat, nilai kuantitas dikali biaya per unit, dan mencakup semua status selain dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_format, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_format ORDER BY s.store_format

cases.answer: In 2025, flagship stores sold 1,648 orders, mall stores sold 13,733, and street stores sold 6,019. Counts exclude cancelled orders, include refunded orders, and use WIB dates.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, COUNT(*) AS stockout_product_days FROM analytics.fact_inventory_daily AS i JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = i.store_id WHERE i.snapshot_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) AND i.on_hand_qty = 0 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY stockout_product_days DESC LIMIT 1

cases.sql: SELECT e.employee_code AS employee_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_in_store_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_employee AS e ON e.employee_id = o.sales_employee_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND e.job_role = 'sales_associate' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY e.employee_code ORDER BY completed_in_store_orders DESC LIMIT 1

cases.answer: Sales associate EMP-00233 served the most completed in-store orders in 2025, with 152 orders. Sales associates are defined as employees with the sales_associate role, and orders assigned to a sales employee are treated as in-store.

cases.sql: SELECT r.region_group, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_region AS r LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY r.region_group
cases.answer: Registered customers by region group: Bali — 975; Jabodetabek — 9,663; Jawa Barat — 1,950; Jawa Tengah & DIY — 2,478; Jawa Timur — 2,612; Sulawesi — 1,146; Sumatera — 1,176.

cases.sql: SELECT p.promo_name, COUNT(*) AS redemptions FROM analytics.fact_promotion_redemptions AS r JOIN analytics.dim_promotion AS p ON p.promotion_id = r.promotion_id GROUP BY p.promotion_id, p.promo_name ORDER BY redemptions DESC LIMIT 1
cases.answer: The most-redeemed promotion was Ramadan Sale 2026, with 1,301 redemptions.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-03-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-04-06' AS DATE)
assumptions: Count all orders placed in the inclusive WIB date range, including orders later cancelled.
cases.answer: There were 281 orders placed during the Lebaran week, counting all orders in the inclusive WIB date range, including those later cancelled.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = CAST('2024-12-12' AS DATE)
assumptions: Jumlah pesanan mencakup semua status, termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan pada tanggal yang ditanyakan adalah 91. Perhitungan mencakup semua status pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE)) AS orders_aug_2026, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) AS orders_sep_2026, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE)) AS order_change FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: Counts all orders regardless of status; change is September orders minus August orders, so a negative value means a decrease.
cases.answer: Orders changed by -4 from August 2026 to September 2026. This counts orders regardless of status, with the change calculated as September orders minus August orders.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') < 6
assumptions: Count all orders regardless of status.
cases.answer: There were 864 orders in 2025 placed between midnight and 6 a.m. Jakarta time. This counts orders of all statuses and excludes orders placed at 6 a.m.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS weekend_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = t.traffic_date WHERE t.traffic_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND d.is_weekend = TRUE
cases.answer: Total pengunjung toko pada akhir pekan di bulan Juli adalah 7.486.

cases.sql: WITH periods AS (SELECT CAST('calendar_q1_2026' AS TEXT) AS period, CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) AS end_date UNION ALL SELECT 'fiscal_q1_fy2026', CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE), CAST('2025-06-30' AS DATE)), order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT p.period, COALESCE(SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)), 0) AS net_revenue_idr FROM periods AS p LEFT JOIN order_net AS n ON n.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY p.period, p.start_date ORDER BY p.start_date

cases.answer: Net revenue was IDR 17.8B for calendar_q1_2026 and IDR 17.3B for fiscal_q1_fy2026. The fiscal period follows an April fiscal-year start.

cases.sql: WITH quarters AS (SELECT d.quarter, MIN(d.date_key) AS quarter_start, MAX(d.date_key) AS quarter_end FROM analytics.dim_date AS d WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.quarter) SELECT q.quarter AS calendar_quarter, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers FROM quarters AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.signup_date BETWEEN q.quarter_start AND q.quarter_end GROUP BY q.quarter ORDER BY q.quarter

cases.sql: SELECT po.received_date AS received_date, COUNT(*) AS purchase_orders FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po WHERE po.po_status = 'received' AND po.received_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.received_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY po.received_date ORDER BY purchase_orders DESC, received_date LIMIT 1
assumptions: Interpreted “receive orders” as purchase orders received from suppliers, grouped by actual received date.
cases.answer: The company received the most supplier purchase orders on 2025-03-04, with 9 orders. This interprets “receive orders” as supplier purchase orders grouped by the actual received date.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
cases.answer: Total net revenue for FY2025 was IDR 74B, using the WIB order date and the fiscal year running from April through March.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
cases.answer: Gross sales selama tahun kalender 2025 adalah Rp 78,1 miliar.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
cases.answer: The average order value of non-cancelled app orders in 2026 was IDR 3.4M, based on available data from January through September.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
cases.answer: Tingkat konversi sesi di aplikasi selama tahun 2025 adalah 8,3%.

cases.sql: SELECT c.channel_name AS channel, ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.returned_units, 0)) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.order_item_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_item_id) AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_name
cases.answer: The return rates were Marketplace: 4.2%, Mobile app: 5.5%, Physical store: 3.9%, and Website: 5.3%. The query excludes cancelled orders and uses Jakarta local dates.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, rg.region_group, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS rg ON rg.region_id = s.region_id JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY o.order_id, rg.region_group), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT n.region_group, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.region_group ORDER BY n.region_group
cases.answer: Pendapatan bersih per region group: Bali — Rp 3,47 miliar; Jabodetabek — Rp 36,7 miliar; Jawa Barat — Rp 6,36 miliar; Jawa Tengah & DIY — Rp 10,2 miliar; Jawa Timur — Rp 9,95 miliar; Sulawesi — Rp 3,54 miliar; dan Sumatera — Rp 3,82 miliar. Perhitungan mengecualikan pesanan yang dibatalkan dan mengurangi nilai pengembalian dana.

cases.answer: Arunika Medan Setiabudi had the highest net revenue in September 2026, at IDR 361M.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.status = 'cancelled')) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 4) AS cancelled_orders_pct FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
cases.answer: 3.5%% of orders placed in 2025 were cancelled.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), store_revenue AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.store_id) SELECT s.store_name, t.target_net_revenue_idr, COALESCE(sr.net_revenue_idr, 0) AS net_revenue_idr, t.target_net_revenue_idr - COALESCE(sr.net_revenue_idr, 0) AS shortfall_idr FROM analytics.fact_sales_targets AS t JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = t.store_id LEFT JOIN store_revenue AS sr ON sr.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.month_start = CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND COALESCE(sr.net_revenue_idr, 0) < t.target_net_revenue_idr ORDER BY shortfall_idr DESC

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.is_online, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, c.is_online), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), channel_revenue AS (SELECT n.is_online, SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.is_online) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cr.net_revenue_idr) FILTER(WHERE cr.is_online), 0) AS online_net_revenue_idr, COALESCE(SUM(cr.net_revenue_idr) FILTER(WHERE NOT cr.is_online), 0) AS store_net_revenue_idr, COALESCE(SUM(cr.net_revenue_idr) FILTER(WHERE cr.is_online), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.net_revenue_idr) FILTER(WHERE NOT cr.is_online), 0) AS online_minus_store_net_revenue_idr FROM channel_revenue AS cr
assumptions: “This year” means calendar year 2026; order data is available through 30 September 2026.
Online includes website, app, and marketplace; stores means non-online sales channels. Sales means net revenue after discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
